name: Paradero Todos Santos
insider_take: This desert oasis sits where the Pacific meets the Sierra de la Laguna mountains, offering a rare blend of artistic culture and untamed Baja wilderness.
whats_special: Paradero Todos Santos is positioned in Mexico's legendary "Pueblo Mágico" - a town where ancient mission bells still chime and world-class galleries showcase local artisans. The property features minimalist architecture that frames dramatic desert sunsets, while the nearby Hotel California (yes, that one) adds rock-and-roll mystique to this bohemian enclave.
pro_tip: Visit during January-March for perfect weather and migrating gray whale sightings from nearby Punta Lobos beach.
dont_miss: The historic Mission Santa Rosa de Todos Santos (1734), browsing Galería de Todos Santos for authentic Mexican art, and catching sunset at Playa La Cachora - one of Baja's most pristine and uncrowded beaches just minutes away.
pros: Stunning desert-meets-ocean location in artistic Todos Santos
Contemporary luxury design with authentic Mexican cultural touches
World-class spa with indigenous healing treatments
Farm-to-table dining featuring local Baja ingredients
cons: Remote location requires transportation to main attractions
